Not whose field

Three steps, and what each one is worth

Two of them are ours to get right. The third is the weather, and nobody controls that.

01

The farmer films the plot

Inside the app, never picked from the gallery. It saves to the handset first so it works with no signal, then sends itself when there is some.

This proves
That this exact file reached us unaltered, and when it did.
This does not
Where the camera was standing. A phone’s reported location can be faked in one tap, so we label it as claimed.
02

We fingerprint it and anchor the date

The server hashes the bytes it actually received, never a number the phone sends us, batches the day’s hashes into a tree, and writes the root into Bitcoin.

This proves
That the date cannot be moved later. Not by the farmer, and not by us either.
This does not
Anything about what the video contains. A timestamp is a clock, not a witness.
03

Investors fund, the harvest pays

The farmer reports what the crop sold for and what it cost to grow. The server computes each share from those two numbers and pays principal plus that share.

This proves
That every payout traces to one reported harvest and one percentage agreed up front.
This does not
That the harvest figures are true. They are the farmer’s report, which is why investors see the reported numbers and not just the result.

Your phone is the paperwork

Film the plot and it saves to the handset immediately, no signal needed. It sends itself when you have a bar, and you always see which videos are still only on the phone.

Works with no signal. The clip stays on your phone until you send it.

If you invest

Read it, then decide

You are paid your principal plus your agreed share of the profit that actually materialised, never a rate we promised you in advance.

You can lose money here
Crops fail. When one does there may be no profit to share, and a total loss can return less than you put in. There is no capital protection and no guaranteed return. Only commit what you can afford to lose.
